name: dynamic-menu
title: Dynamic Menu
description: Open the menu and explore a submenu
useCases: In a diagram editor, an author opens the export submenu and selects SVG. The app starts the corresponding exporter.
In a report builder, an analyst opens the format list, goes back a level and revisits the export choice.
task: Open the menu and explore a submenu
behavior: Supply format names in formats and connect export through onChoose, which receives the chosen format.
